items.title: Faithfully flat descent for the Picard group when the ring of global sections is semi-local
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a faithfully flat ring map A -> B and a quasi-compact quasi-separated A-scheme whose ring of global sections R is semi-local, an invertible sheaf on X whose pullback to X_B is trivial is already trivial. The proof uses the previous lemma to see that M = H^0(X, L) and N = H^0(X, L tensor -1) are invertible R-modules, applies the structure of invertible modules over a semi-local ring to get M isomorphic to R and N isomorphic to R, chooses generators s and t, and concludes from the last part of the previous lemma that st is a unit, so that s and t define trivializations (proof lines 5796-5804). H2: the reduction from the invertibility statement to an explicit trivialization through generators is the substance, and it is written out.
